scope: The exterior of restored Al Jalali Fort at Old Muscat as photographed on 10 August 2024, with the full mapped fort and open court, harbor-facing gun ports, round bastions, square keep and lower approach tower.

originalReview.notes: The clear 2024 harbor view shows the north round bastion, perforated west curtain, castellated square keep, separate low stair tower and the rocky approach.

quallaSearch.notes: Examined the existing Qualla reference family first. Used its exact first-party 2024 CC0 photograph. The independently licensed Yale painting predates the restored appearance by more than two centuries and was set aside for this scope.
